body:
STEP 1 PLAN (fixed before running; CPU only, no model calls).
Unit ("atom"): each of the engine's 78 condition|direction reading keys (the output a CPU reader must produce; covers the 39 BitMob battery keys).
Data: the 880 stories with Clef's full 328 answers (data/newsreader/labels/clef-q4km.jsonl), replayed in file order, one tick per story, at WORLD:world (records carry no country), via a new script probes/world-engine/sensitivity.py that copies prepare_feed without the model call (expected-impact readings omitted).
Outputs protected: world-level likelihood of each of the 20 decisions (points) and the same for the 8 audiences, read at the end of the replay (prop_at).
1. Replicate noise first: 10 engine seeds, noise on, clean readings. Noise band per output = 95th percentile of |seed_i - seed_j| over all pairs. Written to the ledger before any injection run.
2. Drift limit: an injected run passes if every protected output stays within its noise band of the clean run (drift <= the engine's own noise).
3. Injection (noise off, so drift is paired and deterministic): per key, one at a time, TPR in {1, .8, .6, .4, .2} x FPR in {0, .005, .01, .02, .05}; false negative = drop that reading; false positive = add it with the key's median true strength and the story's own P(recent) and type weight; engine conflict rule applied. 3 injection seeds per cell; drift = mean.
4. Budget per key: the error region (TPR, FPR) inside the drift limit; the knee = the lowest TPR and highest FPR still inside.
5. Ranking: keys ranked by drift at TPR .4, FPR .01 (near the old plateau).
6. Global check: all keys injected together at 3 error levels; if joint drift differs from the sum of single-key drifts by more than 20%, run Morris screening (SALib) over all keys.
Pass bar: noise band and drift limit written first; a budget per key; keys ranked. If it fails (engine reacts to every key or to none): set the target per condition and record why.

title: Contract 1 Gate: BitMob gives happened/announced/opinion/forecast and recent as the engine reads them
definition: classify.read(): gate = (happened>=.5 or announced>=.5) and opinion<.5 and recent>=.3; recent scales amounts
target: Gate accept/reject agrees with Clef on >= 90% of frozen-test stories

title: Contract 2 Conditions: all 39 conditions x up/down with attribute answers in both wordings, engine computes readings and conflicts
definition: classify.read(): per dial/direction attribute means of |0/|1 >= ATTR_MIN; one direction = reading (strength = max attribute mean), both = conflict
target: Engine readings from BitMob answers vs Clef's readings meet the F-0020 tolerance (TPR .9 at FPR .001 or TPR .95 at FPR .0025) on the frozen test

title: Contract 3 Topics: one main choice plus yes/no per each of 48 domains; a story may carry several
definition: classify.place(): tagged if p_choice>=0.2 or p_yes>=0.5; spec ontology-domains.md rule 2; tags restrict expected() via allowed_dials
target: Per-domain AP >= 0.70 vs Clef's tags on most domains (>= 80% of domains with >= 20 test positives); mean topics per story within +-20% of Clef's

title: Contract 4 Country: region then country over 100 countries plus global
definition: classify.ask_country_detailed(): two-step choice; other_here -> global
target: Accuracy >= 90% over all 100 countries + global vs Clef on the frozen test; no top-N cut; any fallback for a country needs an approved exception

title: Contract 5 Expected impact: up/down per condition allowed by the story's topics, plus already-in-effect
definition: classify.expected(): e|dial|up/down noul, done; kept if max>=0.5 and |net|>0.05, top 4
target: Same expected-condition set as Clef on >= 75% of stories

title: Contract 6 Severity: size level per change
definition: classify.severity(): typed choice over rules/impact_levels.csv levels; multiplier = probability-weighted level multiplier
target: Same severity level as Clef on >= 75% of changes

title: Contract 7 So-what summary
definition: Plain-words summary produced by the reader model
target: Open: no training; user decides keep Clef or a template (exception pending)

title: Contract E Engine output: what the engine concludes from BitMob vs from Clef
definition: World engine outputs: where changes land, which resources move, the forecast
target: 300-story replay: engine outputs from BitMob vs Clef differ within the F-0020 tolerance; live hit chain shows no topic/place/condition at > 2x Clef's rate (Wilson rule) with Clef check every 10th story
